incident_spec.summary: Too many connections error in MySQL due to high concurrent PHP scripts and insufficient connection limits.
symptoms: Application errors indicating server is too busy
incident_spec.mechanism: Exceeding the `max_connections` limit in MySQL due to concurrent PHP scripts and application usage.

facts.evidence: The DBA post explicitly mentions increasing `max_connections` to 200.
The post mentions 12 PHP scripts running concurrently.
The post explicitly mentions error code 1040.

assumptions: The application uses non-persistent MySQL connections.
The server has sufficient memory to handle an increased `max_connections` limit.
unknowns: Exact memory configuration of the server
Whether persistent connections (e.g., `mysql_pconnect`) are being used improperly
